blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
A good week is easy when it is organised. At Czarnikow, every weekday has its own tasks.

There are calls on Monday. There are reports on Wednesday. There is a team lunch on Friday.

Today we connect the days of the week with the things we really do at work. Take your time. Every sentence counts.

items.q: When are the calls?
items.why: "There are calls on Monday." — as ligações são na segunda.

items.q: What day is the team lunch?
items.why: "There is a team lunch on Friday." — o almoço em equipe é na sexta.

items.q: What do people do on Wednesday?
items.why: "There are reports on Wednesday." — relatórios na quarta.

items.q: The text suggests that a good week is easier when it is…
items.why: Inferência: "A good week is easy when it is organised." — organização ajuda.

items.q: The text suggests that each day at Czarnikow has…
items.why: Inferência: "every weekday has its own tasks" — cada dia tem tarefas diferentes.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Emma falar sobre a semana dela no Czarnikow. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hello! I am Emma. Let me tell you about my week at Czarnikow. It is simple and I like it.

On Monday, I have a meeting with my team. We talk about the new week. On Tuesday, I call clients. I like Tuesday because I talk to many people.

Wednesday is report day. I sit at my desk and I write reports. It is quiet and calm. On Thursday, I work from home. I do not go to the office, so I have more time in the morning.

Friday is my favourite day. Friday is team lunch. We eat together and we laugh. It is a nice way to end the week.

On Saturday, I rest. Sunday is family day. Then, on Monday, the week starts again. See you on Monday!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What does Emma do on Monday?
options: She has a meeting with her team
items.why: "On Monday, I have a meeting with my team."

items.q: Where does Emma work on Thursday?
items.why: "On Thursday, I work from home."

items.q: What is Emma's favourite day?
items.why: "Friday is my favourite day. Friday is team lunch."

items.q: Why does Emma like Tuesday?
options: Because she talks to many people
items.why: Inferência: "I like Tuesday because I talk to many people."

items.q: How does Emma feel about her week?
items.why: Inferência: ela diz "I like it", "It is quiet and calm" e "a nice way to end the week" — ela gosta da semana.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "I have a big meeting on Monday." Monday is…
items.why: Monday = segunda-feira.

items.q: "On Wednesday, I write my report." Wednesday is…
items.why: Wednesday = quarta-feira.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "On ___, I call my clients. It is the day after Monday."
items.why: Tuesday = terça, o dia depois de Monday (segunda).

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The team lunch is on ___. It is the last workday of the week."
items.why: Friday = sexta, o último dia útil da semana.

items.q: "I work from home on Thursday." Thursday is…
items.why: Thursday = quinta-feira.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "See you on Monday!" This means…
items.why: See you on Monday = a gente se vê na segunda.

items.q: "I work from home on Thursday." This means I…
items.why: Work from home = trabalhar de casa.

items.q: "Let's set up a meeting for Monday." To set up a meeting means to…
items.why: Set up a meeting = marcar/organizar uma reunião.

items.q: "Can you send over the report on Wednesday?" To send over means to…
items.why: Send over = enviar (algo) para alguém.

items.q: "On Friday we catch up at lunch." To catch up means to…
items.why: Catch up = colocar a conversa em dia, trocar novidades.
